name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Legacy of Morgoth
summary: The Lord of the Rings Online: Legacy of Morgoth is the twelfth expansion for the MMORPG, The Lord of the Rings Online (LOTRO). In this new expansion, players must venture to the deserts and marshlands of Near Harad. The expansion continues the epic questline, Song of Waves and Wind, and features 350+ new quests.
